title: Construct the first complete testable Auth Service product candidate
outcome: One immutable in-process Auth Service product candidate is deterministically constructed from an exact DomainSpec source set, composes trusted SQLite input and authorization-state resolution with generated decision logic, returns only ALLOW or DENY, and has complete current functional, exactness, EVF, and formal-regression product-test evidence ready for a separate product-owner decision.
rationale: Existing Auth components and EVF work do not yet form one Project-owned, service-level construction and evidence denominator. This Goal keeps the complete Auth Service as the product, EVF as one sibling test branch, and every approval or authority decision separate from planning and validation.
scope: prototype Auth Service definitions, agent-facing ontology scaffold, Product Capability, and capability-local business ontology
one exact DomainSpec v2 Auth Service source set and deterministic compiled graph and system-ontology scaffolds
generated authorization kernel and trusted-input query, runtime adapter, SQLite providers, trusted command boundary, and in-process service composition
one immutable product candidate and complete functional, exactness, EVF seven-seam, formal-claim, and regression test denominator
product-approval-request eligibility and one exact product-owner approve, reject, or defer decision
exclusions: credentials, login, token transport, HTTP transport, administrative mutation APIs, audit transport, multi-node operation, deployment, and production-security claims
treating recovered or historical Auth and EVF bytes as current product evidence without exact candidate binding
implementation before an admitted service-level Design and separately authorized execution plan
inferring product approval, admission, activation, publication, release, deployment, or external-effect authority from this Goal, its plan, its binding, or a passing validator
owner_route: Auth Foundation Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus DomainSpec v2 owner plus Auth Service implementation owner plus Auth Service product-test owner plus Auth Service product owner

success_conditions.statement: One Auth Foundation Project uniquely owns this Goal and its bounded Auth Service prototype construction.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Project, Goal, ontology view, and ConstructionBinding references close bidirectionally while the Project remains proposed, the Goal remains draft, and authority_effect remains none.

success_conditions.statement: Prototype definitions, Product Capability, capability-local business ontology, and agent-facing scaffold establish complete Auth Service meaning before technical construction.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Every selected term, behavior, property, control, exclusion, owner, residue, and challenge route closes for one prototype epoch without ontology authority inflation.

success_conditions.statement: One exact DomainSpec v2 source set deterministically compiles the Auth Service graph and system-ontology scaffolds.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Two isolated compiles produce byte-identical graph and system-ontology artifacts from an exact source-set, compiler, profile, and registry manifest.

success_conditions.statement: The complete in-process Auth Service composes trusted request-input and authorization-state resolution with generated decision logic and fail-closed binary output.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Generated-source receipts, implementation mapping, component tests, and end-to-end integration tests bind every implementation byte and demonstrate one permitted case plus the complete representative deny matrix.

success_conditions.statement: One immutable Auth Service product candidate and complete product-test denominator reproduce exactly.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Two freezes produce the same sorted artifact and tool inventory, canonical manifest digest, and unique required functional, exactness, EVF, formal-claim, and regression test IDs.

success_conditions.statement: Current collect-all product evidence proves the exact frozen candidate across every required sibling test branch.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Functional and fail-closed service evidence, deterministic exact-byte evidence, the EVF seven-seam campaign, and formal-regression evidence are all evaluable and PASS for the same candidate digest; blocked dependent checks are recorded as not_evaluable.

success_conditions.statement: The exact tested candidate reaches only a separate Auth product-owner approve, reject, or defer decision and then stops before operational authority.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Eligibility binds the exact candidate and complete current product evidence; the immutable owner decision explicitly grants no admission, activation, publication, release, deployment, or external-effect authority.

evidence_requirements: Every CAV2-D65 successor binds the exact current predecessor identity, digest, owner decision where required, validation result, residue, and challenge route.
The complete Auth Service remains the product; EVF remains one sibling product-test branch and cannot substitute for functional, exactness, or formal-regression evidence.

DomainSpec source, compiled graph, system ontology, implementation, frozen candidate, product-test evidence, product approval, and post-approval authority remain distinct artifacts and authority lanes.
Changed acceptance-bound bytes invalidate the candidate-bound evidence and require a new prototype epoch, test epoch, and product decision.

evidence_refs.selector: # Auth Service — D65 Revision 2 Construction DAG
evidence_refs.supports: The planning DAG defines the bounded construction topology, evidence join, layers, and stop boundary.
evidence_refs.claim_limit: Planning candidate only; no implementation, completion, approval, or authority claim.

target_horizon: one bounded Auth Service prototype and product-test epoch; no activation, release, deployment, or external-effect deadline

revision_history.change: Registered the draft Auth Service Goal, bounded product, D65 revision-2 DAG evidence, and prototype-only ConstructionBinding under the proposed Auth Foundation Project.

challenge_route: Challenge ownership and scope through the Auth Foundation Project owner, product meaning through the CyberAlchemy v2 product owner, DomainSpec construction through the DomainSpec v2 owner, implementation claims through the Auth Service implementation owner, evidence claims through the Auth Service product-test owner, product approval through the Auth Service product owner, and any later authority effect through its separate exact owner gate.
